recognize_zh: 骨髓中滿是無顆粒的芽細胞，大小不一，較大的細胞有淡藍色細胞質與清楚的小核仁，較小的核染色較深、細胞質極少；左上角可見一個有絲分裂像，符合淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Blasts of variable size with scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei, some with slight irregularity or indentation
Fine chromatin with one to several small but visible nucleoli in larger blasts
Smaller blasts with denser chromatin and very high N:C ratio
Mitotic figure in the upper left; no Auer rods
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows diffuse replacement by blasts with heterogeneous size. Larger blasts have moderate agranular pale blue cytoplasm, round nuclei, fine chromatin and small visible nucleoli, while smaller blasts have scant cytoplasm and denser chromatin. A mitotic figure is present, and no Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia, with B-lineage assignment dependent on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often show more prominent nucleoli, occasional azurophilic granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive in at least 3% of blasts.
Morphologically indistinguishable; cytoplasmic CD3 by flow establishes T lineage.
Cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain.
